leadText: (Japanese: カナタ Kanata) and (Japanese: ミサキ Misaki) are two minor characters who appeared in Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice. They first appeared battling each other in the Roshan City Pokémon Center. Although Kanata put up a good fight, Misaki ended up being the victor.
